name: Read Past Agent Session
description: Reads a bounded, model-safe transcript projection from one of the running agent's own past sessions. Omit sessionId for the newest visible past session. The current session, missing sessions and sessions hidden by venue policy all return exactly {found:false}. Tool scratch, diagnostics and unanswered turns are omitted.

sessionId.description: Optional 16-byte hex session id. Omit to read the newest visible past session.

maxChars.description: Maximum total content characters. A single oversized turn is truncated. Default 8000.

turnCount.description: Total turns in the safe projection, before response bounds.
